skills.description_zh:
一个离线、可复算的干支命理引擎，不是一个装满断语的提示词。
输入公历生日、时刻、性别与出生地，输出四柱、调候用神、格局成破、20 项神煞、大运与流年；
再看当天：建除十二神、宜忌、吉时、吉方、择日结论。另有风水摆布、姻缘总览、双人合盘、
职业方向与投资文化层。
与大多数命理技能的区别在底层：节气用 Meeus 太阳视黄经算到交节那一分钟（不是近似到日），
真太阳时含均时差，立春与交节当天按时刻分档——这两处错了，年柱月柱就整体错位。
120 格调候、67 事择日、3935 个地点库都在包内，纯标准库，不联网、不调用大模型、不产生额外费用。
缺信息时会明确降级：不默认午时、不默认男性、不猜经度、不擅自做农历转换。
每个结论都带来源标注，「原文」「评注」「通行口诀」三级分开，不把民间说法冒充古籍。
边界：传统术数推演与文化解释，不是科学预测；不构成投资、医疗、法律、婚姻或职业建议。

skills.description: Split one requirement into task packs you can hand to several coding agents at once - by file ownership, with frozen contracts, write-conflict and missing-dependency detection, a per-agent task brief, and a computed merge order. Use when the user asks "can I split this refactor across agents", "how do I run Claude Code and Codex on the same repo without conflicts", "how should I divide work between agents", "how do I merge parallel agent work", "my agents keep colliding", "turn this PRD into parallel tasks", or "should I even go multi-agent". Capabilities: (1) a go/no-go gate - single-file changes, trial-and-error work, hard sequential chains and unfrozen contracts are told to stay serial (2) four ways to cut work ranked by safety: new files vs existing files, by directory, by layer (the one that burns people), rename/refactor as a separate pass (3) a list of always-contended files - dependency manifests, migration dirs, type/contract layers, wiring points - pulled into a serial prerequisite task (4) scripts/split_check.py validates the plan: write conflicts (E003), reading a file whose owner you do not depend on (E004), dependency cycles (E005), unowned contracts (W101), missing acceptance commands (W102), with --repo comparing real files instead of guessing at globs (5) topological merge order where each level is a parallel batch (6) one-command task briefs per agent: files you may change, read-only files, frozen contracts, acceptance commands, explicit non-goals (7) split_check.py suggest scans a repo for candidate ownership blocks with file and line counts. Do not trigger for: running one agent sequentially (just do the work); writing the code itself (use a coding skill); scheduling containers, dashboards or session monitoring (that is Conductor / Orca / vibe-kanban territory); backlog prioritisation (use a project tool).
skills.description_zh: 【Agent Orchestration】Three agents on one repo, and the merge is where you find out they all edited the same type file. Turn "splitting the work" into a checkable step - own files, freeze contracts, run the split check, merge in dependency order. Chinese version: agent-work-split
skills.name: Parallel Agent Planner
